principles: Review the document as a lifecycle process contract, not as prose approval.
Keep B-fb36 done_prepare as the single TEST-to-DONE readiness implementation.
Require every pipeline step to identify proof, missing-proof behavior, and verifier ownership.
drivers: The plan discusses validation framework and gate-adjacent evidence, so high-risk PLAN discipline applies.
The user asked for a concrete implementation plan that can be parallelized safely.
The review must be auditable through Lattice CLI rather than only conversational.

options.name: A: Create a PLAN-phase documentation review story and run story_review
pros: Produces Lattice-native review evidence without starting implementation work.
Tests checklist completeness against the documented plan and flowcharts.
cons: PLAN review cannot prove future command runtime behavior.
It may surface process gaps that are about story setup rather than document content.

options.name: B: Manually self-review the document without a story
pros: Fast and avoids adding review metadata.
Can directly discuss the document content.
cons: Does not exercise the lifecycle review command requested by the user.

options.name: C: Start a full implementation story immediately
pros: Would eventually validate behavior with code and tests.
cons: Premature before the execution plan is reviewed.
Higher conflict risk with existing active stories and larger scope than requested.

chosen: A: Create a PLAN-phase documentation review story and run story_review
rationale: This is the smallest Lattice-native audit that directly matches the user request while avoiding duplicate implementation work or a second DONE readiness truth source.

preMortem.scenario: The review only checks story process artifacts and misses a real flaw in the document.
preMortem.trigger: Checklist items are too generic or do not point to the actual document sections.
preMortem.consequence: The plan appears reviewed but still leaves implementation teams with ambiguous evidence ownership.
preMortem.mitigation: Tie each checklist item to the Step Contract Matrix, flowcharts, B-fb36 boundary, and related source documents.

preMortem.scenario: The plan accidentally creates a second DONE readiness implementation.
preMortem.trigger: story_pipeline_preflight or story_pipeline --to=DONE grows independent merge, refresh, validate, or done_closure logic.
preMortem.consequence: Two truth sources drift and future DONE behavior becomes inconsistent.
preMortem.mitigation: Make done_prepare delegation a hard boundary in the document, story breakdown, and review checklist.

preMortem.scenario: The review story becomes implementation work.
preMortem.trigger: The reviewer asks for runtime commands or code changes before the plan is accepted.
preMortem.consequence: Scope expands beyond documentation review and conflicts with active stories.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep this story at PLAN review level and treat runtime implementation as later P1-P7 stories.
